units.en: As Finland, have Hungary, Estonia, Sapmi, Karelia, Mari El, Udmurtia, Komi, Ostyak-Vogulia, Yamalia and Nenetsia as subjects
⟦0⟧ must be disabled for this strategy to work, since it relies on faction-joining logic which changes with that DLC being active.
Can be easily combined with ⟦0⟧. Go Historical.
Delete your army. Rush down to ⟦0⟧ via the ⟦1⟧ side. You can take the decision for 150 PP to get a bunch of ⟦2⟧ equipment (and 2 free technologies) but don't bother with the other two coup decisions.

As soon as the civil war starts, queue up 12x of the 6-width Infantry division for training. Force-deploy them the second they hit 20% completion. Just walk these units to victory. Towards the end, the other side might manage to field a couple of units, but just walk around them.

You're going to be starved for Political Power for a while. I recommend getting the Silent Workhorse and Nationalist Lutheran Priest with your first free political power. Immediately after that, take the Entice the Masses (Balance of Power), Anti-Democratic Raids, and Anti-Communist Raids decisions in order to stabilize your Public Trust. You'll need to run these raids multiple times most likely. Alternatively (in part), you can just Ban Democratic Parties instead as soon as they drop under 20%.
For focuses, grab ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ immediately. Build your intelligence agency (and do 5 upgrades for the additional spy). Next go for ⟦3⟧.
At this point, ⟦0⟧ will ask to join your faction most likely. If you want to get ⟦1⟧, tell them no. However, if you want this achievement to be over slightly faster, you can say yes.

Build up your relations one by one with ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ (in that order). Have a spy exert Diplomatic Pressure on the current country you're running the decision for as well. Grab the Chief of Army (Army Offense Expert). Once you get 10 Army Experience, remove 2 of your current Infantry battalions from your current division template, and spam out as many as you can physically field, force-deploying them every time you can. The goal is to maximize the manpower you have fielded. This helps scare the AI into joining you.

Now that you're ready, then take the decision to Pressure their government (don't bother with rallies). There are 3 possible outcomes to these decisions: them switching ⟦0⟧, joining your faction, or refusing. If you've done everything here, all three countries should join your faction. ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ might just flip ⟦3⟧ without joining you due to their army size, but that's fine. With your spy in place and relations maxed, you should have just enough acceptance to invite them to your faction manually. ⟦4⟧ should join you directly. If they turn ⟦5⟧ instead, you will probably need to restart. Don't bother doing anything with the Baltic countries with these decisions.
Use your spies to repeatedly prepare collaboration governments in the ⟦0⟧. Do 3 of them unless you get 45% Collaboration rolls on both of the first 2.
Once all of Scandinavia is in your faction, rush down your tree to annex them via ⟦0⟧. Take the Nordic Unity decision to form The Nordic Empire.
If you want to get ⟦0⟧, your faction should right now have 0 other countries in it. Release Iceland as a puppet. Now, when the ⟦1⟧ lose to you later, you'll get that achievement.

Your civilian factory count should even rival the ⟦0⟧ at this point; switch to ⟦1⟧ and just spam out military factories in all of your cores with the best infrastructure. Cut down your army to ~108 divisions and change them all to use a 12-width Infantry template with Heavy Weapons Company regimental support and Support Engineers, Support Artillery, and Support Anti-Air for division support companies at minimum (you can also add in anything else you'd like over time as equipment allows). Set 96 divisions on your border with the ⟦2⟧ and keep 12 back to use to defend against naval invasions. Obviously, you'll be very deep in equipment shortages, but just keep chipping away at them and they should resolve by the time you are attacked in late 1939. Make sure to train your troops before then, too.

During this period, do the focuses in your political tree for all of the crazy army buffs, but also grab ⟦0⟧. Don't bother with the economy tree focuses; there's no point. They were designed with a small Finland in mind, not one that had 100 factories in 1937. When World Tension hits 25%, immediately start prioritizing the ⟦1⟧ branch. Every focus in that section is quite strong, particularly ⟦2⟧. Both support companies offered there are quite good too.

When the ⟦0⟧ declare on you, hold defensively against their initial assault, then slowly micro with small groups to take their supply hubs and naval bases on your frontlines. Then go back to holding your position for a while longer - now their units will suffer heavy attrition on top of the losses from attacking you. When you feel ready (ideally mid-1940), go ahead and push out. You should be able to win against them within a year (i.e. before the Axis attacks them, so you don't have to share anything in the peace conference) just with standard battle planning, though make sure to stop pushing if your equipment values go too far into the negative. If your manpower and equipment allows, you can increase your template to 18-width Infantry over time, but this isn't necessary.

If you did not go for ⟦0⟧ as a companion achievement and instead invited ⟦1⟧ into your faction, they will often be attacked by ⟦2⟧ right now. Accept ⟦3⟧ call to war against ⟦4⟧ (but be careful when reading these - sometimes ⟦5⟧ ends up at war with ⟦6⟧ or even the ⟦7⟧ for some insane reason; make sure you stay out of those wars). If this happens, ⟦8⟧ will join the ⟦9⟧, so you'll get their land for free when you win against the ⟦10⟧.

When the ⟦0⟧ capitulate, you should get ⟦1⟧ if you opted for that. Annex everything from everyone involved in the war and take their navies. Justify a war goal on ⟦2⟧ for one of your claims. When you go to declare war on ⟦3⟧, mouse over the "Declare War" option in the diplomacy menu and see if it says 'Estonia may join the Allies'. If it does say that, declare war on the ⟦4⟧ first before declaring war on ⟦5⟧. You really don't want to fight the ⟦6⟧ if you can avoid it (they aren't hard but they are very annoying with how weak your navy is).

If you still need ⟦0⟧, justify a war goal on them and take them as well. They may have joined the ⟦1⟧ at this point, but that's not really a problem, since you're the foremost world superpower now basically, and there's no way the ⟦2⟧ can handle you and the ⟦3⟧ at the same time.
Make sure to take ⟦0⟧ in the peace conference and then release all the puppets needed for the achievement.
…and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton!
